name: the sidebar handle goes back to document.body
why: Under Event Horizon document.body is EH's body: the handle shows over EH's view and leaves the document on V, and initSidebarCollapse('final') never rebuilds it (org/majkinetor.org, measured 2026-11-08).
grep: the sidebar handle lives in MusicBrainz

name: the hover-card host #mb-stat-tooltip goes back to document.body
why: _initStatTooltip() makes the one card host at start-up and keeps it by reference; in EH's body it leaves the document on V and no hover card ever shows again.

name: the sticky-bar mask #mb-vsb-mask goes back to document.body
why: initStickyFilterBars() makes the mask once at start-up and keeps it in _vsb.mask; in EH's body it is gone after V.

name: _saBody() returns document.body
why: The helper itself neutralised: every host follows document.body again, so the handle, the card host and the mask all land in EH's body.

name: the toolbar menu panel is created in document.body (healed on open)
why: Recorded as a known overlap, not a gap: createToolbarMenu()'s open handler re-attaches its panel to _saBody() whenever it is elsewhere, so a panel born in EH's body and lost on V is rebuilt on the first open. The spec cannot see the creation site, by design.
